title: Sara Duterte addresses claims in NBI affidavit on money delivery allegations
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte issued a formal response on Monday evening regarding the affidavit submitted by dismissed policeman Rodulfo Gracioso Jr. to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI).
